raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your regional logistics team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we recommend clarifying your requirements before scheduling a discovery meeting.

Our team is ready to assist with workflow coordination and account reporting as part of Cedar Systems' offerings. A discovery meeting would be an excellent opportunity to establish integration requirements tailored to your organization.

Please let us know a convenient time to proceed.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
